purpose: Turn the current AI Visibility pilot from first-party entity optimization into a controlled external-evidence and answerability program without fabricating business facts.

workstreams.name: Official Profile Alignment
workstreams.rule: Only mark a field VERIFIED after directly observing it on the public profile.

workstreams.name: Independent Evidence Discovery
workstreams.goal: Find legitimate third-party places where the real business/entity can be represented or independently referenced.

workstreams.name: Answerability Upgrade
workstreams.goal: Strengthen existing core pages around frozen benchmark questions using concise direct answers and FAQ structure.
workstreams.rule: Prefer upgrading existing pages over creating thin duplicate pages. All operational claims must come from verified facts or be explicitly conditional.

workstreams.name: Freshness and Provenance
workstreams.goal: Add honest reviewed/updated metadata to factual service content when the content has actually been reviewed.
workstreams.rule: Never manufacture freshness dates merely for ranking signals.

workstreams.name: Fixed Prompt Retest
workstreams.goal: Retest the frozen 50-prompt benchmark and record observable sources, entity mentions, citations and competitors.
workstreams.rule: Public search results are not direct evidence of ChatGPT/Gemini/DeepSeek/Doubao citation or recommendation.

do_not_do: claim AI recommendation without direct observation
